items.html: And this is the secret of what is written in the Tikkunim, “I sleep,” corresponding to the last Hey; for in the annulment of the light of the Nekudim, “I sleep,” in the secret of sleep. Also, “I sleep” [Ani Yeshena] has the same letters as “second” [Shniya]; for Hochma is the first Hey, and she is second to Keter. For it is known that the Taamim are Keter, and the Nekudot are Hochma, and the tagin are Bina, and the letters are the seven lower ones. It turns out that the eye is the discernment of Hochma, which are the Nekudot; and this is the reason that the sages of the congregation were called “the eyes of the congregation,” as it is written, “And it shall be, if it be done in error by the eyes of the congregation,” etc.
